headline: Nvidia forecasts $1tn in AI-driven orders by 2027
summary: Chief executive Jensen Huang said surging demand for artificial intelligence tools could drive Nvidia's sales towards $1 trillion within two years. The forecast was reported by Euronews.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips used in data centres, making its order outlook a key gauge for the AI investment cycle. Its results influence semiconductor and technology stocks broadly.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The chief executive projected Nvidia's AI-driven sales could reach $1 trillion within two years.
